payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results achieved by the Jasper model on various datasets, including LibriSpeech, Wall Street Journal, and Hub5'00.

claims.text: Jasper achieved a state-of-the-art (SOTA) result of 2.95% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean using a beam-search decoder with an external language model.
Jasper also reported a WER of 3.86% on LibriSpeech test-clean using a greedy decoder without a language model.
Competitive results were obtained on the Wall Street Journal and Hub5'00 conversational evaluation datasets.
